verdict.rationale: Gumloop's core interaction model is natural language: you give an agent a goal and it decides which tools to call and in what order. You can also reconfigure the agent conversationally, for example telling it to update its instructions or turn a workflow into a skill. The same agents can be commanded through Slack @mentions, Teams and email. Missing for 10: no evidence that product-level setup (triggers, connectors, access roles) can be done through natural-language commands, and no independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: You give an agent a goal and a set of tools, and it figures out how to get there: which tools to call, in what order, and when to ask you for input.
tell it: "Update your instructions so you always do it this way" or "Turn this into a skill."
Connect your Gumloop agents to Microsoft Teams so anyone in a channel can interact with them using a simple @mention.
Give your agent a dedicated email address so anyone can interact with it by sending an email.
